configuration.query: What is the average opportunity value from accounts based in US
configuration.rephrase: The query will join opportunity and account, find out those opportunities where parent account's address1_country is US, then calculate the average of estimatedvalue on these opportunities.
configuration.standardsql: SELECT AVG([Opportunity].[estimatedValue]) AS [averageOpportunityValue] FROM [Opportunity] JOIN [Account] ON [Opportunity].[parentAccountId] = [Account].[accountId] WHERE [Account].[address1_country] = 'US'
